test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **'Maintainence'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word is **Maintainence.**** **There is no such word in English.
 
• 
 The correct spelling is "Maintenance" which means the process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.
 
 
• 
 Hence, the correct answer is** option 1**.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us explore the meaning of the given options

 
 
• Motivate - provide (someone) with a reason for doing something.
 
• Occasion - a particular event, or the time at which it takes place.
 
• Tendency- an inclination towards a particular characteristic or type of behaviour.
